[2026-08-05] MUSIC QUALITY BAR, for anyone generating background music: (1) LOUDNESS-MATCH beds or every cross-fade is a volume jump — measure BS.1770, do not eyeball. Careful: deriving K-weighting from RBJ cookbook formulas does NOT reproduce the standard (shelf 0.2577 dB low at 997 Hz = exactly how far the calibration tone then misses -3.01 LKFS); round-trip the tabulated 48k coefficients through their analog prototype. (2) SEARCH for loop points (spectral+level match, beat-snapped) — generated music never loops sample-perfect. (3) Ask for a tempo but MEASURE it, and expect autocorrelation to return a multiple (2x for night, 3/2x for title) — use the brief's BPM as a prior. (4) Generate lossless, master once, encode at the end. (5) Naming real IP/artists is a 400 ToS block; negative prompts backfire; say 'it starts immediately' or you get a fade-in the maintainer will reject.

[2026-07-31] DEPLOY-SPEED pt.2 — DOWNLOAD ONCE (maintainer: 'how often does the music change? Feels this could have been a 120x improvement if we also stop downloading music and sound effects [that] already download'): the file-size fix only shrank each fetch — the browser was still RE-FETCHING every audio asset on every load. Root cause in MY domain: the engine's audio /assets urls carried no `?v=<sha>`, so the server's setCacheHeaders gave them `no-cache` (revalidate every load). Fix mirrors client/src/assetver.ts: new composer/engine/assetver.ts withAudioV() stamps `?v=<VITE_GIT_SHA>` on every audio byte url — soundUrl + musicStreamUrl (catalog.ts), composerFoley bundle takes (foley.ts), title/night bundle music (titleTheme.ts). The server then grants `immutable` 1yr (same rule the client art already uses; the .js/.css hashed-asset rule never covered .wav/.mp3/.ogg). Metadata/viewer JSON stays UNVERSIONED (getJson keeps cache:no-cache) so a new track's analysis is picked up fresh. Net: audio downloads ONCE per deploy, then zero requests until the sha changes (a new deploy = new sha = new url = one fresh fetch). Dev unaffected (sha=dev → no-op). Typecheck + client build green.
